title: Device peak-throughput constants (sourced, provenanced)
description: Sourced peak-throughput constants for the roofline prior, emitted as a sidecar (the existing tools/hrd_profiler/device_properties.json carries cache geometry and is left unchanged). Each numeric constant is wrapped in a value+source+provenance object whose source is one of live_device_query / vendor_whitepaper / derived and whose provenance string is non-empty, so an unsourced or fabricated peak (or a guessed SM count) is rejected at parse time. additionalProperties:false at every layer.

source_enum.description: How the constant was obtained. live_device_query = read from cudaGetDeviceProperties / device attributes; vendor_whitepaper = NVIDIA published spec; derived = computed from other sourced constants (the derivation is in provenance).

provenance.description: Non-empty provenance: the exact query, vendor document, or derivation formula. An empty provenance is rejected so a fabricated peak cannot pass.
